name: shootika
description: Shoot on-model product photos for your store from your AI assistant: find products without model photos, start shoots, review the frames and publish the ones you approve. Works with a Shopify store or any other online store.

interface.longDescription: Shoot on-model product photos for your store from your AI assistant: find products without model photos, start shoots, review the frames and publish the ones you approve. Works with a Shopify store or any other online store.
defaultPrompt: Which of my products have no model photos yet?
Shoot my newest product on a model and show me the frames.
How many frames do I have left this month?

publication.release_notes: Four skills: shoot products, review frames, cast models, connect. README rewritten as the listing.

positive.description: Check the plan and the frames left before doing anything that costs.
positive.prompt: How many Shootika frames does my store have left this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_account and states the store name, its plan, and the frames left this month. Starts no shoot.

positive.description: Browse the catalog that shoots start from.
positive.prompt: List my newest products in Shootika and say which ones have photos I could shoot from.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_products and lists products with their titles, noting which have product photos. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Add a product from a public image URL (web app store).
positive.prompt: Add a product called "Sage knit sweater" to Shootika with this photo: https://shootika.tryoncdn.com/website/source/flatlay.jpg
positive.expected_behavior: Calls add_product with the title and the image URL, then confirms the product was added and whether the photo was fetched.

positive.description: Start a shoot only after the person agrees to spend a frame, then wait for it.
positive.prompt: Shoot my newest product on a model in a studio look.
positive.tools_triggered: get_account, list_products, get_product, list_scenes, start_shoot, get_shoot
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the product, its photo and a ready scene, says the shoot uses one frame and asks to go ahead. After a yes, calls start_shoot with a request_id, then get_shoot until the frame is ready, and shows the preview with its full-size link.

positive.description: Publish a frame only with explicit consent.
positive.prompt: Show me my latest finished frame, and publish it if I say yes.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_shoots, shows the latest ready frame and asks whether to publish it. Calls approve_frame only after the person says yes, then confirms it was published.

negative.description: Editing prices is outside Shootika: it only adds and removes its own frames. The assistant should say so and change nothing.
negative.prompt: Change the price of my linen dress to 40 dollars.

negative.description: Shootika has no customer or order data. The assistant should explain that and call no Shootika tool.
negative.prompt: Show me the email addresses of customers who bought my linen dress.

negative.description: A general writing task with no product photography in it. The assistant should answer without calling any Shootika tool.
negative.prompt: Write a short Instagram caption for our autumn sale.
